text:
ryan.design: Quick sync — prototyped a compact first-run banner + a sample-project strip beneath the hero. Wanted feedback on accessibility, copy, and whether we should use a top banner vs a transient toast.

Aisha.product: I worry newcomers will miss a small strip. Banner grabs more attention. Could we also add a subtle 'Samples' affordance in the left rail for later discovery? :thinking_face: 

sam.eng: FYI left-rail pill means touching nav state + persisted flag. Banner is fastest to ship. Also: keyboard focus and screen-reader order will need attention either way. 

mika.accessibility: Accessibility checklist off the top: 
- auto-show must announce via `aria-live` (polite)
- dismiss must be reachable via keyboard and update accessibility tree
- CTA text must be descriptive, not just 'Try'
- sample cards need `role=button`, `tabindex=0`, and visible focus ring
Top banner is simpler for SR users than ephemeral toasts. 

ryan.design: Current copy in the prototype: "Try sample project" and generic subtitle. Aisha — any copy recs? 

Aisha.product: Suggest: "Explore starter project — Chat Demo" (inject project name). For subtitle: "Get a running demo in under 2 minutes." More helpful than generic. We'll A/B test two variants. 

sam.eng: Implementation notes: for logged-in users we can persist dismissal server-side (`users.settings.show_sample_banner=false`). For anonymous, fallback to `localStorage`. Also will lazy-load images for cards. 

mika.accessibility: Good call on server-side persistence. Two more nits: 
1) If using a toast, keep it persistent until explicit dismiss — don't auto-timeout. Auto-dismiss toasts are invisible to many keyboard/SR users.
2) Make sure we don't trap focus; focus should move into banner when user tabs, and tabbing past should go back into main flow. 

ryan.design: Noted. I'm leaning to top banner with persistent dismiss and injected project names. Also track events: show/dismiss/cta. 

aisha.product: Events we need: `onboarding.sample_banner_shown`, `onboarding.sample_banner_dismissed`, `onboarding.sample_cta_clicked`, `onboarding.sample_launched`. Add metadata for variant id. 

sam.eng: Will add those. Small API example for tracking: 
```
trackEvent('onboarding.sample_cta_clicked', { project: 'chat-demo', variant: 'A' })
```

mika.accessibility: I'll draft a short keyboard + screen-reader acceptance checklist and attach to the ticket. Also request contrast check for primary CTA against the banner background. 

ryan.design: Action items: 
- update copy per Aisha (A/B copy)
- implement server-side dismissal for auth users + localStorage fallback
- add aria-live announcement + keyboard focus rules (Mika)
- prefer top banner over toast given accessibility concerns
- track events listed by Aisha/Sam
Anyone object or missing something? 

mika.accessibility: No objections. I'll post the checklist here when ready. 

aisha.product: I'll prepare copy variants and sample names list. 2-week A/B test window suggested. 

console-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging at 2023-07-14 17:00 PDT; will post smoke results after deploy. 

ryan.design: Thanks folks :thumbsup:
